stages.name: Boom intact
stages.rule: No reds; at most 2 yellows; none in B or C

stages.name: Stress building
stages.rule: No reds but 3+ yellows, or any yellow in B or C

stages.name: Price break
stages.dotcom: Mar 10 - Apr 14, 2000: Nasdaq -25% in five weeks

stages.name: Funding window closes
stages.dotcom: Apr - Jun 2000: IPO calendar dries up, rounds pulled

stages.name: Revenue misses
stages.rule: Red in D1, D3 or B3

stages.name: Capex cliff
stages.rule: Red in B1 or B2. This is when 'the bubble is popping' becomes the right headline
stages.dotcom: Jan - Apr 2001: telecom capex cut 20-40%; Cisco $2.2B write-down

stages.name: Credit event
stages.rule: Red in C1, C4 or C5

amplifier.rule: Pillar F never changes the stage. LOW = 0 red and at most 1 yellow; MEDIUM = 0 red and 2+ yellow, or exactly 1 red; HIGH = 2+ red. HIGH shortens the watch horizon and flags C1, C4, C5, D2 as at elevated risk.

signals.name: Rotation: AI leaders vs equal-weight S&P, 20 days
signals.r: Lag > 10 pts while RSP flat or up

signals.name: Single-day rout
signals.y: NVDA or SOX -5% in a day
signals.r: NVDA -10% or SOX -8% in a day, or two -5% days in a week

pillars.name: Capex and guidance
pillars.role: The true confirmation of a pop. Detects stages 3 and 4.

signals.name: Hyperscaler capex guidance
signals.r: Two or more cut 2027 guidance, or any announces a pause

signals.name: Data-center pauses and lease cancellations
signals.r: Company-confirmed pause at a hyperscaler, Stargate, xAI or top neocloud

signals.name: Nvidia results vs consensus
signals.r: Miss, guide below, or sequential data-center decline

signals.name: Supply chain: TSMC revenue, memory prices, ODM orders
signals.y: TSMC growth halves or memory flat
signals.r: TSMC YoY negative, memory falling, ODM cuts

signals.name: AI debt deal reception
signals.r: Pulled deal, covenant breach, downgrade to junk, or a fund gating redemptions

signals.name: Neocloud health (CRWV, NBIS, IREN, APLD)
signals.r: Bonds < 80, going-concern language, or a peer default

signals.name: Lab revenue run-rate growth (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI)
signals.y: Growth rate halves or targets missed
signals.r: Flat or down, or layoffs at a top lab

signals.name: Private-market pricing
signals.y: Secondaries 10-20% below, or a round/IPO delayed
signals.r: Down round at a top-5 lab, secondaries > 25% below, or tender cancelled

signals.name: H100 rental price, 3-month change
signals.r: < -30% or idle-capacity reports

signals.name: Enterprise adoption
signals.y: Flat growth or negative ROI studies
signals.r: Disclosed seat declines or major customers cutting AI budgets

signals.name: AI-startup casualties
signals.y: Several notable shutdowns in a month
signals.r: A wave, or a secondhand GPU glut

pillars.name: Sentiment and narrative
pillars.role: Coincident or contrarian. Never a confirmation.

signals.name: BofA FMS 'AI bubble' tail-risk share
signals.r: > 45% with rising cash

signals.name: Narrative volume vs 12-month average
signals.r: > 3x or new high

signals.name: Public composite trackers
signals.r: All three deteriorating, or boomorbubble 2+ red gauges

signals.name: Insider selling and IPO froth
signals.y: Record insider sales or day-one doublings
signals.r: IPO withdrawals

pillars.name: Macro transmission
pillars.role: Amplifier only, added Sep 17. Never sets the stage.

signals.name: Term premium or auction reception
signals.r: > 1.0%, or two consecutive tails

signals.name: Inflation regime: breakeven, Brent, CPI
signals.r: Breakeven > 2.7%, or Brent > $100 with CPI > 4%

signals.name: Fed path priced by futures and dots
signals.r: 3+ hikes priced, or 2027 median dot > 4.5%

source_tiers.name: Primary, no narrative incentive
source_tiers.examples: SEC filings, company IR for own numbers, Fed, FRED, BLS, Treasury, rating agencies, exchange prices, Polymarket, BofA FMS

source_tiers.name: Wire and major financial press
source_tiers.can: Change a color if dated within 7 days
source_tiers.examples: Reuters, Bloomberg, FT, WSJ, AP, CNBC, Nikkei, Japan Times

source_tiers.name: Specialists, inside their domain
source_tiers.can: Change a color in their domain only
source_tiers.examples: SemiAnalysis, TrendForce, The Information, DCD, GlobalCapital, ASR, SFA, TechCrunch, Axios, Epoch AI, FactSet Insight, GPU price indices

source_tiers.name: Aggregators and secondary
source_tiers.can: Leads only; cannot change a color
source_tiers.examples: Motley Fool, 24/7 Wall St, Benzinga, GuruFocus, Seeking Alpha news, TipRanks, MarketBeat, Investing.com, crypto news, MT Newswires Market Chatter, Substacks, X

source_tiers.name: Interested parties
source_tiers.can: Opinion only, with an incentive tag
source_tiers.examples: Companies on themselves, CEOs, short sellers, underwriter-strategists, vendor blogs, subscription trackers, committed bull or bear publishers

calendar.what: SoftBank $10-20B USD/EUR institutional bond for OpenAI financing; NY roadshow ran Sep 14-17, still unpriced at Sep 17 close. Wide print, downsizing or pulled deal turns C4 red. (Separately, SoftBank's Y1tn retail bond already priced fine at 4.75% on Sep 4, issued Sep 17 -- not the tracked instrument.)
Micron fiscal Q4. Softening DRAM commentary turns B4 yellow.
TSMC September revenue. Under 25% YoY turns B4 yellow.
BofA October fund manager survey; Anthropic IPO marketing; CPI release.
Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta Q3 earnings: first 2027 capex guidance. Two or more guiding flat or down turns B1 red and the stage to 4.
FOMC. Dots imply one more hike; BofA expects two.
Nvidia Q3 FY27. Guide below consensus or sequential data-center decline turns B3 red.

changelog.t: Framework created; baseline set at Stage 1 with 1 red and 8 yellows.
C1 moved from baseline-relative to absolute bands after an unverified CDS print would have scored green.
Five-tier source register with incentive tags added; T4/T5-only figures cannot change a color.
Pillar F macro transmission added as an amplifier (10y level, MOVE, term premium, inflation regime, Fed path).
Dashboard moved to GitHub Pages; the daily routine now appends a row to data/runs.json each weekday.
